question: What devotional response is sought from Kaumārī as world-mother?
premises: Kaumārī is addressed as mother of the world.
The worshipper asks her to accept worship.
The worshipper offers salutation to her.
inference: Kaumārī, as world-mother, is petitioned to accept worship and receive salutation.
plain_english: Accept this worship, O Kaumārī, mother of the world; salutation indeed to you.
